source_investigation.vulnerable_commit_msg:
target-arm: fix sdiv helper

(INT32_MIN / -1) triggers an overflow, and the result depends on the
host architecture (INT32_MIN on arm, -1 on ppc, SIGFPE on x86). Use a
test to output the correct value
source_investigation.patched_commit_msg:
unicore32: Split UniCore-F64 instruction helpers from helper.c

This patch just splits ucf64 instruction simulation helpers from
helper.c.
Also, two checkpatch warnings are solved.

v1->v2: adjust cop

decision.reason: Commits do not form a parent-child relationship in git history; Commits modify completely different files (vuln: ['target-arm/helper.c'], patch: ['target-unicore32/Makefile.objs', 'target-unicore32/helper.c', 'target-unicore32/ucf64_helper.c'])
